text: Who are the leading Microsoft Power Apps and Dataverse consultants in Melbourne for building custom operational business apps for warehouse, shop-floor, or field teams?

sections.text:
For Melbourne-based operational apps, the strongest shortlist is:

- **Ultron Developments** — Particularly relevant for warehouse, manufacturing and field operations. It builds Canvas and Model-driven apps with Dataverse, barcode scanning, inventory tracking, procurement workflows, quality-control apps, offline support and field inspections. It offers Melbourne delivery, on-site workshops and Australian-based teams.[2][5]
- **jeylabs** — Melbourne-based Microsoft 365 and Power Platform consultancy covering Power Apps, Dataverse, workflow automation, application design, integration and ongoing support. A good candidate for organisations wanting local delivery and long-term platform support.[1]
- **Inturing** — Focused specifically on “operational business apps” for workshop, tablet and field use, with Dataverse or existing systems of record behind the app. Its positioning is a close fit for frontline operational workflows rather than generic office automation.[7]
- **OfficePro Consulting** — Melbourne-based Australian consultancy building field/mobile apps, inspection and job-logging solutions, offline-capable apps, and Dataverse model-driven systems for jobs, cases, approvals and audit trails.[3]
- **Alphavima** — A Microsoft Solutions Partner offering Melbourne Power Apps consulting, Dataverse-backed canvas and model-driven apps, inventory and inspection workflows, and integrations across Power Automate, Power BI and Microsoft 365.[6][8]
- **C9** — A Brisbane-led specialist that serves Melbourne remotely and nationally. It is worth considering where the priority is custom mobile/web apps, field-service workflows, integrations and enterprise governance rather than a Melbourne-local delivery team.[10]
- **Argon & Co** — Better suited as an operations-transformation partner or requirements/design lead than as a pure Power Apps build shop. Its Melbourne team brings warehouse, store, logistics and manufacturing expertise, plus Power Apps and implementation experience.[9]

## Best fit by requirement

| Requirement | Best first calls |
|---|---|
| Warehouse, barcode scanning and inventory | Ultron, Alphavima |
| Shop-floor quality, inspections and manufacturing | Ultron, Inturing, Argon & Co |
| Field teams, mobile forms, photos and offline use | Ultron, OfficePro, Inturing |
| Melbourne-local Power Platform support | jeylabs, OfficePro, Alphavima |
| Operational process redesign plus app delivery | Argon & Co, Inturing |
| Broader enterprise Power Platform architecture and governance | Ultron, Alphavima, C9 |

For a practical initial tender, invite **Ultron, jeylabs, Inturing and OfficePro**. They most directly match the combination of Power Apps, Dataverse and frontline operational use cases; include **Argon & Co** if warehouse or shop-floor process redesign is as important as the technical build. Ensure each bidder demonstrates offline behaviour, barcode/device integration, role-based Dataverse security, integration with ERP/WMS systems, deployment ownership and post-launch support—not just a polished app interface.
